name: CloningScenarios
intro: CloningScenarios 是 LAB-Bench 中的分子克隆工作流评测，用于评估模型执行生物实验规划任务的能力。
build_method: 论文作者与签约生物学专家人工编写、修订和质检分子克隆多步场景题，并保留公开/私有污染监测划分
eval_feature: LAB-Bench子基准, 人类高难, 零样本思维链, 禁用工具, 污染监测
build_method_en: Manually authored, revised, and quality-controlled by paper authors and contracted biology experts, with public/private contamination monitoring splits
eval_feature_en: LAB-Bench sub-benchmark, human-hard, zero-shot chain-of-thought, no tools, contamination monitoring
intro_en: CloningScenarios is a molecular-cloning workflow evaluation within LAB-Bench for assessing biological experiment planning capability.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the LAB-Bench paper arXiv:2407.10362 and the official FutureHouse dataset. Cloning Scenarios is a LAB-Bench sub-benchmark rather than a standalone paper. Paper authors and contracted biology experts manually author and revise 41 human-hard multiple-choice questions covering realistic multi-step molecular cloning workflows with plasmids, DNA fragments, enzymes, protocol choices, distractors, and an explicit insufficient-information option. Some questions share a scenario but remain independently answerable. Approximately 80% is public and 20% is retained privately for contamination monitoring, with a canary string in the release. The original study evaluates zero-shot chain-of-thought without tools, parses a final answer or abstention, reports Accuracy over all questions, Precision over attempted questions, and Coverage of attempted questions across three runs, and compares against a molecular-biology expert baseline covering all 41 questions.
